name: Shoulder-blade Glides
summary: Small, isolated shoulder-blade movements — up and down, then forward and back — to find where "shoulders set" actually is.
steps: Sit or stand tall with arms by the sides (or lie on the back with arms to the ceiling).
Up and down: shrug the shoulders towards the ears, then slide them down.
Forward and back: reach the arms forward to spread the shoulder blades, then draw them gently together.

layers.title: Seated or standing
layers.text: Arms by the sides or forward.

cues:
Elbows stay straight; the blades move, not the arms.
Ribs and neck stay quiet.
Small and slow.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
